deviations: rdrobust: R package rdrobust 4.1.1 with vce='cr1' + cluster=code_city as the equivalent of Stata rdrobust vce(cluster code_city); p=1, q=2, triangular kernel, masspoints='off', default mserd bandwidth.

geonear (ellipsoid) nearest-neighbour matching reimplemented with a WGS84 Vincenty inverse distance; nearest Wave-2 deadline station per Wave-1 deadline station, kept if <= 400 km, controls replicated per match (joinby).
City-day aggregation for the search data takes auto_date/phase from the station with the latest auto_date (gsort -auto_date); ties broken by station id.
notes: Translated Prepare_Data.do (station_day, station_month, did_ddl_match, search_city_month) and Tables.do (Table 1 Panels A/B, Table 2 Panel A col 2) to R with data.table/fixest/rdrobust. attempt-1 was exploratory (column orders, timing; no RESULT lines). The single scored run (final) reproduced all 13 claims to the reported precision (e.g. 34.7, 34.9, 27.5, 64.7, 57.1, -0.005, 60.3, 31.4, 66.5, 0.24, N=176426, 11.03, 8.73); effective Ns and bandwidths also match the paper (e.g. 232,326 obs, h=263). No claim-comparison refinement was made.
